svg.title: The layers that stop the motor
svg.desc: Four layers. First, the feed's own limits on marks, time, current and the outlet. If the main loop stalls, a timer's motor lease stops the motor 200 ms after the last renewal. If a stop doesn't take, the timer retries it every 10 ms. If the owner's beat is more than 1 second old while driving, the watchdog is not fed and resets the board about 4 seconds later, which puts the motor pins in standby.
svg.text: Marks, time, current and the outlet. A stop here ends the feed with a named reason.
A timer interrupt stops the motor 200 ms after the owner's last renewal. Measured: 0.18 to 0.2 s.
The timer tries the stop again every 10 ms, even if the loop isn't running.
the owner's beat is over 1 s old
It resets the board about 4 s later, and the motor pins go to the driver's standby.
